curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Picture the eight-sided red stop sign and the red and white yield triangle, contrast a full stop with slowing and giving way, then walk through where to stop: the stop line, the crosswalk, or just before the intersection.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign and stopping rule; contrast cards for stop versus yield shapes, colors and duties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing an approach to a sign and asking what it looks like, what it requires or where to stop.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Separate the Wrong Way sign, which means you are already in an oncoming lane, from the Do Not Enter sign at a road opening, then cover One Way, lane control arrows and the Keep Right sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign; contrast cards for Wrong Way versus Do Not Enter and lane control arrows versus Keep Right.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a sign or situation and asking what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the posted maximum under ideal conditions and the duty to slow when conditions are unsafe, then the interstate minimum, the city default, the commission's power to adjust limits, and the default maximums by road type.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per limit; contrast cards for the city default versus the interstate minimum and the rural expressway versus urban interstate defaults.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a road and asking which default limit or speed duty applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Move from the round advance warning sign to the X-shaped crossbuck and its yield duty, then the rules for racing trains and shifting gears, the stop duty at flashing lights and gates, the stopping distance and the second-train check.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per crossing rule; contrast cards for advance sign versus crossbuck and yield at a crossbuck versus stop at lights or gates.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a crossing and asking whether to yield, stop, or wait.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show the fluorescent orange work zone sign and common sign wording, why extreme care is needed, the conduct rules inside any work zone, the minimum fines for speeding or passing, and why knowing the zone types helps.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per work zone rule; contrast cards for general conduct versus the fine rule and orange signs versus their wording.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a work zone and asking what the driver should do or what the guide says applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Compare the shoulder work zone with the lane closure, then the fixed flagging operation with the moving mobile work zone, its protective vehicle and flashing arrow panel.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per zone type; contrast cards for shoulder work versus lane closure and flagging versus mobile zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a work zone setup and asking which type it is and how to respond.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Sort green or brown guide signs from blue service signs, then read route signs by shape and number, interstate loops and spurs, the direction exit numbers rise, and the emergency reference markers on the shoulder.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign or numbering rule; contrast cards for guide versus service colors, odd versus even routes and loops versus spurs.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a sign color, route number or exit direction and asking what it tells the driver.
